_comment: CP7 fixture (M-shaped): shaped after lane M's own CP3-CP5 extraction of `_load_state` out of pkg.module_a into a new sibling pkg.module_b. files_likely mixes a genuinely new path (pkg/module_b.py, which does not exist in this fixture tree) with an already-existing one (pkg/module_a.py), so classify() must fail safe to brownfield-modify rather than being read as greenfield-create. done_when has no parity wording at all. tests.command runs test_moved_helper.py as the ONLY suite, so it must never trip the CP4 report-race hazard.
done_when: _load_state is callable from pkg.module_b and every caller imports it from there
the extraction does not change _load_state's return value for any existing input

cases.title: pre-existing planned case, must survive the merge untouched
cases.given: a path that already exists on disk
cases.then: it returns the same dict shape as before the move

notes: Pre-existing note, must survive the full pass byte-for-byte unchanged.
